verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The train slows for a station no one gets off at.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Fog holds the platform sign

so long we forget

what town we were promised.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A stranger checks her watch, then checks

the fog again — as if the hour

might clear before the place does.
motifs: waiting for a place to appear

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The watch says the right time

for a station that isn't listening —

we board anyway, trusting

the tracks more than the clock.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Someone else's ticket

falls from an empty seat —

we read the destination twice

before the wind takes it back.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The rails hum a name

no one on board remembers choosing —

we lean toward it anyway.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A window fills with trees we don't recall planting —

still, someone waves

from a house we must have lived in.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The conductor punches holes

in a ticket we never bought —

each small dark window

lets in a little more sky.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
Snow starts on the far side of the glass —

by the time it reaches us

it has already forgotten falling.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
We ask the stranger beside us for the hour —

he shows us his bare wrist

and we both nod, satisfied.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
No one wrote this train down anywhere —

still it arrives, always,

at the platform we were just leaving.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The lost-and-found box fills with gloves

no hand will claim —

winter keeps what winter needs.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
The conductor punches a hole in nothing —

we hold up our tickets anyway,

proof we meant to go somewhere.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Someone folds the timetable into a boat —

it floats past every station,

never asking to be believed.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
The paper boat sinks at last —

somewhere a station light

blinks on for no one, right on time.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
A moth finds that same light —

circles it once, twice,

then leaves before deciding why.
